It’s not just an IT issue—it’s a shared responsibility across every role and function within an organisation. As the cyber landscape grows more complex, businesses need a strategic ally that deeply understands their challenges and the opportunities ahead.

How we can help 

PwC brings together the global reach and local expertise to help organisations navigate cybersecurity and privacy challenges. PwC works alongside you to manage cyber risks holistically, equipping your teams to safeguard value, drive innovation, and lead with confidence in a digital-first world.  


Global network

Our practice of over 8,000 professionals from around the world offers the scale and experience to manage threats across borders and industries. 

Technical experience meets strategic insights

From identity and access management, cloud, security events and monitoring to organisation enablement and reporting, we combine deep technical knowledge with experience working at all organisational levels—from boardrooms to shop floors—creating alignment between cybersecurity initiatives and business goals. 

Subject matter specialists

Our team includes former senior regulators, law enforcement, and industry executives who bring firsthand insights into managing high-profile cyber incidents. 

Alliances ecosystem

We collaborate with leading software providers and cloud hyperscalers to deliver solutions tailored to your needs. 


PwC works alongside you to manage cyber risks holistically, equipping your teams to safeguard value, drive innovation, and lead with confidence in a digital-first world.

Innovation that protects and empowers 


Innovation fuels growth but introduces new challenges that require careful navigation. According to  PwC’s 2025 Global Digital Trust Insights  survey, organisations are leveraging technologies like generative AI, quantum computing and Cyber Risk Quantification (CRQ) to stay ahead of emerging threats.  

Generative AI enhances threat detection and response capabilities but also increases the attack surface, as noted by 67% of security leaders. Quantum computing presents transformative possibilities while demanding a rethink of cryptography and security strategies. CRQ provides actionable insights for prioritising investments and strengthening resilience, yet adoption remains uneven, with significant room for growth. 

How we can help 

We help organisations understand where they are today in relation to emerging trends and work closely with our global alliances-- leading technology providers and cloud hyperscalers -- to deliver innovative solutions tailored to your organisation’s needs.    

Our team includes technical specialists and thought leaders who guide you in adopting these transformative technologies responsibly. From developing AI-driven threat detection capabilities to addressing the cryptographic challenges of quantum computing, PwC helps you use the power of emerging technologies into a source of resilience and competitive advantage. 

Read more 




























Outsmart the adversaries 













Outsmart the adversaries 


Today’s cyber threat landscape is increasingly unpredictable, with cloud-related threats, hack-and-leak operations and third-party breaches topping the list of concerns for security executives, according to  PwC’s 2025 Global Digital Trust Insights  survey. Alarmingly, organisations feel least prepared to address the threats they find most concerning.    

As the attack surface expands with technologies like AI, connected devices and cloud platforms, staying ahead requires strategic investments, cross-functional collaboration and real-time response capabilities. 

How we can help 

PwC’s global cyber threat intelligence capabilities enable you to stay ahead of the evolving cyber threat landscape. We provide timely, tactical and strategic insights into emerging threats, supported by a team of former law enforcement officials, intelligence experts, and cyber specialists. Whether you need a threat modeling program, real-time intelligence or a maturity assessment, PwC helps your organisation identify, prioritise and respond to adversaries effectively. By leveraging our alliances with leading technology providers and our global cyber network, we help you build proactive defenses and create a resilient organisation ready to counter even the most sophisticated threats. 

Read more 




























Stay ahead of the regulatory curve 













Stay ahead of the regulatory curve 


Regulatory compliance is evolving rapidly, reshaping the way organisations approach cybersecurity and privacy. According to the  PwC 2025 Global Digital Trust Insights  survey , there’s a significant difference between CEO and CISO/CSO confidence in their ability to comply with these regulations. The survey found a 13% point gap in confidence between CISOs/CSOs and CEOs in their AI and resilience compliance.  

How we can help 

We work with organisations to navigate the complexities of cybersecurity regulations with ease and confidence. Our global team, including former regulators and industry leaders, can help with the evolving demands of regulation like NIS2, DORA, Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act and SEC disclosure rules. By aligning your cybersecurity strategies and frameworks with global standards, we help you stay ahead of regulatory challenges while safeguarding trust and ensuring operational resilience
